comparison.objective: Transfer a loaded tray from temporary support to a receiving shelf before withdrawing.
comparison.physical_skill: Support and transport a tray while retaining two tins; no small-tool alignment or impact.
comparison.success_condition: Body reports tray transfer, contents retained, and hand withdrawal, but provides no numeric scoring rubric or specs.
comparison.reason: Load transfer and retention are meaningfully different from contact-loaded insert finishing and loose tang collection.
